title: Export links
description: Review the filtered links and choose a file format.
scope: {count, plural, one {# matching link} other {# matching links}}
scopeHelp: Exports every matching link across all pages. Changing the filters updates this whole export.
deliveryHelp: Fewer than 5,000 links download directly. Larger exports run in the background and are available for 24 hours.
csvHelp: CSV can be imported back into Shortn, preserving destinations, available keys and tags.
ready: {count, plural, one {# link ready to download} other {# links ready to download}}
reviewHelp: Browse 25 links per page. The export includes all matches, not just this page.
empty: No links match these filters. Change the filters to prepare an export.
historyHelp: Find background exports here. Files and job history expire after 24 hours.
emptyHistory: No background exports match these filters.
background: You can leave this page. Find this export in Export history.

errors.failed: The export could not finish. Refresh the status or prepare a new export.
errors.forbidden: You no longer have access to this export. Ask a workspace admin for help.
errors.feature_required: Your plan does not include this export. Review your plan or ask a workspace admin.
errors.unavailable: Exports are unavailable. Try again later.
errors.not_found: This export is unavailable or has expired. Prepare a new export.
errors.expired: The download has expired. Prepare a new export.
errors.invalid_export: Check the format and filters, then try again.
errors.idempotency_conflict: The export settings changed. Prepare the export again.
errors.invalid_state: The export has already finished. Refresh its status.
errors.storage_unavailable: Private storage is temporarily unavailable. Refresh the status later.
errors.archive_too_large: This export is too large. Narrow the filters and prepare a smaller export.
errors.export_cancelled: Export cancelled. You can prepare a new export.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again to download the export.
